'''''Star Wars: Crimson Empire''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Mike Richardson]] and [[Randy Stradley]] and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] from [[December 10]], [[1997]] to [[May 20]], [[1998]]. Part of a [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire (series)|larger series]], its sequel, ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood|Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood]]'', was released later in 1998 and [[1999]]. ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost|Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost]]'', ''Crimson Empire''<nowiki/>'s second sequel was later released in [[2011]] and [[2012]].
